I've noticed that I have a few extra inventories on my person. These seem to be tied to various actions I can perform.

The first is my spell inventory. This is where I can store spells that I've created. I can access this inventory by pressing the 'R' key by default.

The second is my codex inventory. This is where I can store items that I want to keep track of in this codex. I can access this inventory by pressing the 'C' key by default.

The third is my spell book inventory. This is where I can store spell books that I've created. I can access this inventory by pressing the 'B' key by default.

I can change these keys in the controls menu.
